dedupe_keys.name: akm albania licence database iii 2 b licensed waste collection transport storage and recycling operators 2012 to august 2026 excel

description: This workbook is Albania's register of licences in category III.2.B, which covers companies licensed to collect, transport, store and recycle waste. It is published by the National Environment Agency (AKM) on its open data page, alongside databases of environmental impact assessment decisions and type A and B environmental permits. Coverage runs from 2012 to August 2026, with about 678 licence rows split into sheets for 2012-2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026. Each row gives the licence number, the operator's name and NUIS tax number, the licence codes, the licensed activity, the validity date, the operator's address and its technical director. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): CC-BY-4.0 (licence link on the AKM open-data page; the site footer also says all rights reserved). Access is free of charge. Simulation uses: building a national inventory of private waste collection and recycling operators to model collection networks, capacity planning for treatment, and tracing which operators serve which districts. Related records: the England waste operations permit register (data-ea-waste-operations-permit-register) is a comparable permit list, and Eurostat municipal waste statistics (data-eurostat-env-wasmun) give national totals. The underlying files were not downloaded, so their contents are not verified here.
